title.narrative: Construction of the Al-Bakriya Charitable Dialysis Center in Duan District, Hadhramaut Governorate, Republic of Yemen

description.narrative: Completion of the construction and finishing of the dialysis center.
Establishing a kidney dialysis center within Al-Juhi Hospital in Duan District, Hadhramaut Governorate, Republic of Yemen, to serve patients suffering from kidney failure.

Provide basic dialysis services, currently unavailable in the area, for patients suffering from chronic kidney failure, directly contributing to improving their quality of life and easing their suffering.
Disbursement for "Construction of the Al-Bakriya Charitable Dialysis Center in Duan District, Hadhramaut Governorate, Republic of Yemen" in Yemen, implemented by Taibah Development Foundation
